name: omnibase/restaurant
description: A restaurant on omnibase: the dining room and its layouts (a floor-plan editor, a QR poster per table), meal services and table reservations (availability under a lock, a public form, a management link, ICS), the menu (dishes as omnibase/marketplace products, sections, set menus, EU allergens), ordering at the table by QR code (sessions, rounds, tickets), the pass for the staff, and the delivery and booking platforms through omnisense/omnifood.

suggest.omnisense/omnifood: The delivery and booking platforms (omnifood/ubereats, omnifood/deliveroo, omnifood/justeat, omnifood/thefork): their orders become tickets on the pass, their reservations join the book, the menu and the out-of-stock dishes are pushed to them.
suggest.omnisense/omnipulse: What guests say elsewhere: the rating and latest reviews on the restaurant's page, the dashboard's tile (restaurant.reviews), through the family's reviews (Omnipulse\Registry, Omnipulse\Bridge\Twig\OmnipulseExtension) and one of its review providers below
suggest.omnipulse/google-reviews: Google reviews (Places API; Business Profile API with the owner's access: every review, and whether it was answered), with omnisense/omnipulse
suggest.omnipulse/tripadvisor: Tripadvisor (Content API): the rating, the latest reviews, the link to write one, with omnisense/omnipulse
suggest.omnipulse/trustpilot: Trustpilot: the TrustScore, the latest reviews and whether they were answered (with a business user), with omnisense/omnipulse
